title: </sub>  Define the human-only terminal miss record
text:
</sub>  Define the human-only terminal miss record

When every compared reviewer is clean but a human records a swept-category defect, this new clause requires a “terminal miss record” for both the sweep-enabled review and the external reviewer, but the adjudication enum defines outcomes only for compared findings and provides no code or record shape for a defect with no finding. `ronda_miss` can represent Ronda missing a human-found issue, but no defined value represents the external reviewer's miss, so implementations must invent incompatible evidence or cannot close this cohort head. Add an explicit record type/code and include it in the terminal-outcome and transition rules.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L45-L45](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/8c28ba8c8f42b22cb569f6d4a6d25002886be8e0/AGENTS.md#L45-L45)
rationale: Author fixed it: Fixed in 40b89f7. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
